As a dispatch lead, I've seen how SLA failures are often blamed on people—techs calling in sick or a dispatcher missing an important detail. But more often, it's the scheduling and data that let us down. Missed deadlines can stem from lack of visibility into travel times, skill sets, and overlapping job assignments. Slatebridge’s solution isn't just about software; it's about giving dispatchers the tools they need to make informed decisions in real-time. 

Tomorrow, **10 AM ET**, I’ll walk you through how our new dispatch board simplifies this complex task, making sure each tech gets the right job, at the right time, every time. You'll see three key features: automatic skill and location matching, SLA countdowns, and a clear, centralized dispatcher board. 

Join us to learn how you can turn scheduling data into a superpower for your team. [JOIN LINK]
